timeBasis.eventAt: UTC. When eventPrecision is day, midnight represents the date only.
timeBasis.knownAt: Reconstructed cutoff for replay. A date-only publication becomes eligible at 12:00 UTC the following day to account for publisher time zones. Block and epoch cutoffs are historical clocks, not an archive ingestion receipt.

title: 第三次减半区块
Third halving block
body: 区块 630,000 包含 3,134 笔交易。矿工领取 7.15968084 BTC，其中协议补贴 6.25 BTC，其余 0.90968084 BTC 来自手续费。
Block 630,000 contains 3,134 transactions. The miner claimed 7.15968084 BTC, comprising the 6.25 BTC subsidy and 0.90968084 BTC in fees.

7: 区块时间为 2020-05-11 19:23:43 UTC。此回放取下一块引用该区块的区块头时间 2020-05-11 20:02:50 UTC 作为可引用截点。
Block timestamp: 2020-05-11 19:23:43 UTC. The replay cutoff uses the next block header referencing this block, at 2020-05-11 20:02:50 UTC.
13: 核对 Coinbase 交易的所有输出，再减去 6.25 BTC 协议补贴，可复算矿工领取的手续费。
Sum all coinbase outputs and deduct the 6.25 BTC subsidy to reproduce the fees claimed by the miner.

title: Dogecoin 调低小额输出门槛
Dogecoin lowered its recommended dust threshold
body: Core 1.14.6 将建议的尘埃输出门槛从 1 DOGE 降到 0.01 DOGE。交易所最低提币额和实际手续费需从对应场所取证。
Core 1.14.6 lowered its recommended dust threshold from 1 DOGE to 0.01 DOGE. Exchange withdrawal minimums and actual fees need separate venue evidence.

3: 计算小额转账约束时读取实际节点的尘埃策略，提现场景另查场所最低额度。0.01 DOGE 是该版本的建议值。
Check the active node’s dust policy for small transfers and the venue minimum for withdrawals. This release recommends 0.01 DOGE.

title: 合并后的首个执行区块
First execution block after the Merge
body: 区块 15,537,394 的难度为 0，包含 80 笔交易。Astarter 历史快照取 06:44 UTC 为判断截点，保留了区块哈希和原始回包。
Block 15,537,394 has zero difficulty and 80 transactions. Astarter’s reconstructed 06:44 UTC snapshot retains the block hash and original response.

7: The original block is timestamped 2022-09-15 06:42:59 UTC. The project replay uses a decision cutoff of 2022-09-15 06:44:00 UTC.
10: 快照保留区块哈希、父哈希、难度和 80 笔交易的数量。推断买卖方向还需同一时间窗内的市场成交。
This snapshot retains the block hash, parent hash, difficulty and transaction count of 80. Directional market activity requires trades from the same window.

title: Circle 披露 SVB 储备敞口
Circle disclosed its SVB reserve exposure
body: Circle 披露其在 SVB 的储备为 33 亿美元，约占当时全球 USDC 储备的 8%。储备披露说明发行方敞口，复盘 ETH 上的卖出价格还需池子成交记录。
Circle disclosed $3.3 billion at SVB, around 8% of global USDC reserves at the time. This measures issuer exposure. Reconstructing the Ethereum sale price requires pool trades.

7: Event: 2023-03-12. Source publication date: 2023-03-13. Only the date is available, so replay includes it from 2023-03-14 12:00:00 UTC.
3: 将发行方赎回、链上池报价和实际成交分项回放。33 亿美元为全球储备敞口，不能按 ETH 地址直接归因。
Replay issuer redemptions, pool quotes and fills separately. The $3.3 billion was a global reserve exposure and cannot be attributed to Ethereum addresses.

title: ARB 治理代币的 L2 地址
ARB governance token on Arbitrum One
body: Offchain Labs 的主网部署清单将 l2Token 记为 0x912C…6548。核对治理代币时使用 Arbitrum One 的合约地址，链名和代币符号一并校验。
The Offchain Labs mainnet deployment file identifies l2Token as 0x912C…6548. Match this Arbitrum One address and network before attributing governance-token activity.

10: 同一份清单分别列出 l2Token、治理合约和金库。归类 ARB 转账时取 l2Token 的完整地址，再核对实际 Transfer 事件。
The same file lists the L2 token, governor and treasury separately. Match the full l2Token address before classifying ARB Transfer events.

title: Base 合约部署回执
Contract creation receipt on Base
body: Base 区块 3,200,550 的创建回执记录地址 0x9401…8631，状态为成功。部署本身只能证明合约创建，首笔成交要从交易池核对。
The successful creation receipt in Base block 3,200,550 identifies contract 0x9401…8631. The deployment establishes contract creation. Its first trade requires pool evidence.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2023-08-28 02:40:47 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2023-08-28 02:40:47 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
10: 创建交易回执的 status 为 0x1，contractAddress 为 0x9401…8631。该回执可验证部署，首笔交换需读取具体池的 Swap 事件。
The creation receipt reports status 0x1 and contractAddress 0x9401…8631. It verifies deployment. The first swap requires a pool swap event.

title: Aerodrome 部署清单核对 AERO
Aerodrome’s deployment list identifies AERO
body: 协议仓库的 9 月 1 日版本将 0x9401…8631 列为 AERO。将项目清单与 Base 上的创建回执对照，可核验资产身份。
The September 1 version of Aerodrome’s deployment list identifies 0x9401…8631 as AERO. Compare that mapping with the Base creation receipt to verify the asset.

10: 项目部署清单与 Base 创建回执中的合约地址一致。这两项证据提供代币身份和创建时间，发行时市价仍需市场成交。
The project deployment list matches the Base creation receipt. Together they establish token identity and creation time. Launch price still needs market trades.

title: Base 原生 USDC 与 USDbC 分流
Native USDC and bridged USDbC on Base
body: Circle 于 9 月 5 日公布 Base 原生 USDC，合约为 0x8335…2913。桥接版本 USDbC 使用独立合约，比较深度或转账额时按各自地址统计。
Circle announced native USDC on Base on September 5 at 0x8335…2913. Bridged USDbC uses a separate contract. Measure depth and transfers against each address independently.

10: 用 Base chain ID 8453 和完整合约地址匹配原生 USDC。汇总池子深度时将 USDbC 单列，避免同名资产混合。
Match native USDC with Base chain ID 8453 and the full contract address. Keep USDbC separate when aggregating pool depth.

title: ARB 申领截止使用 L1 区块高度
The ARB claim deadline used an L1 height
body: 治理配置将申领结束高度设为 18,208,000。这个以太坊 L1 区块的时间为 9 月 24 日 20:20:23 UTC，Arbitrum One 上的申领交易需另取回执。
The governance configuration sets the claim end height to 18,208,000. This Ethereum L1 block is timestamped September 24 at 20:20:23 UTC. Individual Arbitrum One claims require L2 receipts.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2023-09-24 20:20:23 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2023-09-24 20:20:23 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
3: 按以太坊 L1 高度 18,208,000 截断申领窗口。核查某笔申领时，同时保留 Arbitrum One 的交易和 L1 时钟依据。
Cut off the claim window at Ethereum L1 height 18,208,000. To review a particular claim, retain its Arbitrum One transaction and the L1 clock reference.

title: Solana 发布 v1.17.20
Solana v1.17.20 published
body: Solana Labs 在 11:36:44 UTC 发布 v1.17.20。此时可确认客户端已经发布。共识是否恢复，还需核对网络出块。
Solana Labs published v1.17.20 at 11:36:44 UTC. The release is timestamped. Confirming consensus recovery requires separate network evidence.

10: 客户端发布记录可核验版本和发布时间。评估网络可用性还要观察已最终确认的槽位是否持续推进。
The release verifies the client version and publication time. To assess availability, check whether finalized slots continue to advance.

title: 停链后从哪个槽位恢复
Recovery checkpoint after the halt
body: 2 月 9 日的报告回溯，2 月 6 日约 09:53 UTC 网络停止最终确认，从槽位 246,464,040 重启，14:55 UTC 恢复共识。期间的行情缺口与链上成交须分别记录。

The February 9 report dates the finalization halt to about 09:53 UTC on February 6. Validators restarted from slot 246,464,040 and consensus resumed at 14:55 UTC. Quote gaps and on-chain fills need separate evidence.

7: Event: 2024-02-06 14:55:00 UTC. Source publication date: 2024-02-09. Only the date is available, so replay includes it from 2024-02-10 12:00:00 UTC.
3: 以恢复共识的 14:55 UTC 划分窗口。恢复后的第一笔策略交易仍需交易签名、槽位和结果。
Split the replay at the reported 14:55 UTC consensus recovery. The first subsequent strategy fill would still require a signature, slot and result.

title: Dencun 公布激活窗口
Dencun activation window announced
body: 以太坊基金会公布主网激活点为信标链 epoch 269,568，预计 3 月 13 日 13:55 UTC。公告可用于预设观察窗口，实际出块和 Blob 使用量另行核对。

The Ethereum Foundation scheduled mainnet activation for beacon epoch 269,568, around 13:55 UTC on March 13. This dated notice sets the observation window. Blocks and blob usage require chain evidence.

7: Event: 2024-02-27. Source publication date: 2024-02-27. Only the date is available, so replay includes it from 2024-02-28 12:00:00 UTC.
3: 以 epoch 269,568 为观察起点，激活后再读取执行块的 Blob gas 用量。公告没有给出实际 Blob 数量。
Monitor epoch 269,568, then read blob gas from execution blocks after activation. The announcement supplies no observed blob count.

title: Dencun 首块的 Blob 用量为零
Zero blob gas in the Dencun activation block
body: 区块 19,426,587 包含 37 笔交易，Blob gas 用量为 0。判断 Blob 需求需要观察后续区块。
Block 19,426,587 contains 37 transactions and consumed zero blob gas. Demand estimates require observations across subsequent blocks.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2024-03-13 13:55:35 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2024-03-13 13:55:35 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
13: 首块的 Blob gas 为 0。下一轮判断网络使用量时，在连续区块中统计 Blob gas 和有 Blob 的区块占比。
The first block used zero blob gas. For the next observation, measure blob gas and the share of blocks carrying blobs across a continuous window.

title: 第四次减半，矿工收入反升
Fees outweighed the fourth halving
body: 补贴由 6.25 降到 3.125 BTC，但相邻两块的矿工实领从 7.29455386 升至 40.75061499 BTC。区块 840,000 的手续费贡献了 37.62561499 BTC。
The subsidy fell from 6.25 to 3.125 BTC. The miner payout rose from 7.29455386 BTC in block 839,999 to 40.75061499 BTC in block 840,000, including 37.62561499 BTC in fees.

7: 区块时间为 2024-04-20 00:09:27 UTC。此回放取下一块引用该区块的区块头时间 2024-04-20 00:10:54 UTC 作为可引用截点。
Block timestamp: 2024-04-20 00:09:27 UTC. The replay cutoff uses the next block header referencing this block, at 2024-04-20 00:10:54 UTC.
13: 将相邻两块的 Coinbase 输出按补贴和手续费拆分。该样本解释矿工收入的变化，判断现货买盘还需交易场所的主动成交。
Separate subsidy and fees in each adjacent coinbase transaction. The pair explains miner payouts. Spot buying needs venue-level taker trades.

title: USD₮ 上线 TON
USD₮ launched on TON
body: Tether 于 4 月 19 日宣布 USD₮ 上线 TON。记录覆盖发行方确认的网络支持，原生 Toncoin 的买入量和池子深度仍需从各自市场取得。
On April 19 Tether announced USD₮ on TON. The announcement establishes network support. Native Toncoin purchases and pool depth require market-level observations.

3: 将 TON 上的 USD₮ 和原生 Toncoin 分开观察。若要评估发行后的使用情况，需按相同链和代币统计实际转账。
Track USD₮ on TON separately from native Toncoin. To measure post-launch usage, count transfers for the relevant chain and token.

title: Cardano 进入 Conway 的 epoch 507
First block of Cardano’s Conway epoch 507
body: Koios 将 epoch 507 标记为 Conway。首个区块于 9 月 1 日 21:45:46 UTC 生成，提供新时期记录的起点。
Koios identifies epoch 507 as Conway. Its first block was produced on September 1 at 21:45:46 UTC, establishing an anchor for observations in the new era.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2024-09-01 21:45:46 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2024-09-01 21:45:46 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.

title: Conway 首个完整 epoch 的基线
A full-epoch baseline for Conway
body: epoch 507 结束时共收录 20,803 个区块、349,397 笔交易。比较活跃度时应选择同为完整 epoch 的窗口。
Epoch 507 closed with 20,803 blocks and 349,397 transactions. Use equally complete epochs when comparing activity.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2024-09-06 21:44:51 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2024-09-06 21:44:51 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
13: 这个五天窗口的分母是 20,803 个区块，合计 349,397 笔交易，平均每块约 16.8 笔。
Across this five-day epoch, 349,397 transactions in 20,803 blocks averaged about 16.8 transactions per block.

title: BNB 销毁地址收到 177.27 万枚
1.77 million BNB sent to the burn address
body: BNB Smart Chain 区块 43,620,556 记录一笔 1,772,712.363 BNB 转往 0x000…dEaD。链上字段给出转账数量和去向，解析每项销毁构成还需发行方说明。
Block 43,620,556 records a transfer of 1,772,712.363 BNB to 0x000…dEaD. The transaction gives the amount and destination. Its component breakdown needs issuer evidence.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2024-11-01 06:14:02 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2024-11-01 06:14:02 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
10: 交易 value 为 1,772,712.363 BNB，接收地址为 0x000…dEaD。该条公开记录覆盖一笔发送，无法归因到用户交易。
The value sent to 0x000…dEaD was 1,772,712.363 BNB. This public record covers one transfer and carries no user-trade attribution.

title: 第 29 次 BNB 销毁的两项构成
Two components of the 29th BNB burn
body: BNB 基金会披露，常规销毁为 1,710,142.733 BNB，另有 62,569.63 BNB 属于 BToken 调整。分析常规销毁趋势时，须先剔除这项调整。
The foundation attributed 1,710,142.733 BNB to the regular burn and 62,569.63 BNB to a BToken adjustment. Isolate the adjustment before comparing recurring burns.

3: 比较常规销毁时使用 1,710,142.733 BNB；统计本次全部销毁时加上 62,569.63 BNB 的 BToken 调整。
Use 1,710,142.733 BNB for recurring-burn comparisons. Add the 62,569.63 BNB BToken adjustment when measuring the total burn.

title: Sui 停止处理交易约 150 分钟
Sui transaction processing paused for ~150 minutes
body: Sui 公告回溯，11 月 21 日约 09:15–11:45 UTC 主网停止处理交易。回放该窗口时应标记链上交易不可用，交易所行情单独核查。
Sui’s incident report places the transaction-processing halt at approximately 09:15–11:45 UTC on November 21. Mark chain execution unavailable in that window and examine exchange quotes separately.

7: 事件时间记录为 2024-11-21 11:45:00 UTC。来源在 2024-11-21 20:56:28 UTC 发布，相关复盘从发布时起可引用。
The event was dated 2024-11-21 11:45:00 UTC. Its source was published at 2024-11-21 20:56:28 UTC, when the review becomes eligible.
3: 约 150 分钟的停链区间单独标记。若用交易所成交价复盘，场所和时间需与链上执行窗口分列。
Mark the roughly 150-minute halt separately. For reviews using exchange fills, retain venue and time apart from the chain execution window.

title: Etna 公布 C 链费率下限
Etna scheduled a lower C-Chain fee floor
body: AvalancheGo v1.12.0 计划于 12 月 16 日 17:00 UTC 激活 Etna。ACP-125 将 C 链基础费下限从 25 调至 1 nAVAX，单笔成本仍由实际 gas 和费率决定。
AvalancheGo v1.12.0 scheduled Etna for December 16 at 17:00 UTC. ACP-125 lowers the C-Chain base fee floor from 25 to 1 nAVAX. Transaction cost still depends on gas and the effective price.

3: 在公告窗口后核对主网 C 链区块的 baseFeePerGas；计算单笔交易成本，读取其 gasUsed 和 effectiveGasPrice。
After the scheduled window, verify C-Chain baseFeePerGas. To reconstruct a transaction’s cost, inspect its gasUsed and effectiveGasPrice.

title: Pectra 激活区块
Pectra activation block
body: 区块 22,431,084 记入 95 笔交易，使用 1,179,648 单位 Blob gas。此值只覆盖该区块，可与相同时长的历史窗口对照。
Block 22,431,084 contains 95 transactions and used 1,179,648 blob gas. This is one block of activity; comparisons need a matching observation window.

7: 回放采用链上时间 2025-05-07 10:05:11 UTC；原始系统首次收到数据的时间未知。
Replay uses the on-chain time 2025-05-07 10:05:11 UTC. The original first-seen time is unknown.
13: 这份基线只覆盖 1 个区块、95 笔交易。要评估升级后的持续需求，需选择前后等长的区块窗口。
This baseline covers one block and 95 transactions. Assessing persistent post-upgrade demand requires equal-length windows around activation.

title: RPC 可读时，交易仍会超时
RPC reads continued during a write outage
body: 1 月 14 日的主网停滞持续约 6 小时。RPC 可返回最近已认证的状态，写入却会超时。复盘时应核对检查点是否推进以及实际交易回执。

The January 14 mainnet stall lasted around six hours. RPCs served the last certified state while writes timed out. Review checkpoint progression and actual transaction receipts before attributing fills.

7: 事件时间记录为 2026-01-14。来源在 2026-01-15 21:38:45 UTC 发布，相关复盘从发布时起可引用。
The event was dated 2026-01-14. Its source was published at 2026-01-15 21:38:45 UTC, when the review becomes eligible.
3: 验证写入能力时，同时检查最新认证检查点的时间和交易状态。RPC 响应成功只能确认读取路径。
Check both the timestamp of the latest certified checkpoint and transaction status to assess write availability. A successful RPC read verifies the read path.
